blocks.content: Contact points are the destinations where notifications are delivered. Each contact point contains one or more integrations (email, Slack, PagerDuty, webhooks, and more).
To view contact points, complete the following steps:
Navigate to **Alerts & IRM > Alerting > Contact points**.

The Contact points page shows all configured destinations. Each entry displays:

| Element | What it shows |
|---------|---------------|
| **Name** | The contact point name |
| **Type** | Integration type (email, Slack, etc.) |
| **Policies** | How many notification policies use this contact point |

Notice the **default contact point** — the one assigned to the default notification policy. Every Grafana instance starts with a default contact point.

You can create additional contact points for different teams or escalation levels. Grafana supports 20+ integration types.

A contact point can have **multiple integrations**. When a notification is sent to a contact point, all its integrations fire simultaneously.

For example, a contact point named `Critical alerts` could contain both a PagerDuty integration and a Slack integration, notifying both channels at once.
In the next milestone, you'll review what you explored.
